Yukino is M3X Muse’s song writer and voice trainer. Despite being the best singer out of the three, she doesn’t like to speak loudly and would often hide in the shadow of the other two members. She’s secretly Yulia’s mommy girl and likes to cuddle and vent to her. She dislikes Mizuki, which is her opposite, but they get along just fine.
